h:
我创建了这个简单的工作流程，以便与正常的 Lora 加载程序一起自动提示，因为我一直面临 xlabs lora 加载程序版本严重缓慢的问题。这很好用。

更新 3.0：必须让这个有点混乱才能让它运行得更快。 KSampler 使用负面提示并减慢生成速度。元数据未正确存储。现在问题已经解决了！
更新3.2：组合独立的节点并组织工作流程，使其看起来简单，没有意大利面条线。
我用的Lora上传在下面印度女孩服装/珠宝/连衣裙/配饰/脸部 v1.0 - 爆炸 |通量 LoRA |奇维泰

如果您喜欢我的工作，请通过 Buzz 捐款来支持我，我会用它来培训 Lora！衷心感谢那些给予小费的人！ :) 你让我很开心！

o.en:
I created this simple workflow to have auto-prompt along with normal Lora loader as I have been facing severe slowness with xlabs lora loader version. This works great.

Update 3.0: Had to make this little bit messy to make it run faster. KSampler was using negative prompts and slowing down generations. Metadata was not getting stored properly. Now the issues are fixed!
Update 3.2:Combined the independent nodes and organized the workflow to make it look simple without spaghetti lines.
The Lora I used is uploaded underIndian Girls Attire/Jewelry/Dress/Accessories/Face v1.0 - Blast | Flux LoRA | Civitai

If you like my work, please support me by making Buzz donation, I would use it for training Lora! Heartfelt thanks for the ones who have tipped! :) You made my day!
